data.name: 3 Hour Eco Tour
data.headline: Fun and educational for all age groups!
data.description: On our three hour ecotour you will experience one of the most popular adventures we are known for, we will take you for an exciting and scenic cruise through the Ten Thousand Islands, where our Captains and Guides will provide information about the ecology of this unique ecosystem. You'll search for dolphins and learn all about our local population. After cruising through the mangrove islands, we will stop on a private beach in search of the most exotic tropical sea shells that the Gulf coast is known for. This is a very informational adventure that will keep small children and adults engaged the whole time. Our boats are very kid friendly. Comfortable seating and a ladder off the front of the boat for easy loading and unloading right onto the beach.
data.highlights:
Want to go shelling but also want to see dolphins? This is the tour for you! Two hours are spent looking at our local dolphin population and an hour spent on an isolated beach hunting down the beautiful shells. 

This excursion is perfect for adventure seekers and those who want an in-depth lesson on our local ecosystem, wildlife, hurricane history, and areas history in development. It is the perfect adventure to get the ultimate adventure here in the Ten Thousand Islands.

This family friendly adventure will have your family wanting to join us each and every year. Your family will have come off the tour having gained so much local knowledge and memories that last a life time!
data.itinerary: When you arrive at the park, you will be instructed by a crew member where to park, how to get a parking pass, and where to wait for the tour. You will be waiting in the shaded pavilion area until called for your tour. If you are not approached or you do not hear your name called, please find a crew member in one of our company shirts, they say Florida Adventures and Rentals on them. Your group will be brought down to the dock and assisted to board the boat. Your captain will do a safety briefing and your tour will begin. Our 3 Hour Ecotours travel all around the islands south of Marco Island and stop on one of the isolated islands for about 1 hour to 1 1/2 hours. Your crew will provide you with interesting facts and information about the ecosystem, history, and wildlife you come across throughout the tour. As you are walking the beach looking for shells, your captain and guide will assist in finding shells or answer any questions you may have. You are also welcome to swim, just ask your crew the best/safe place to do so. The tour will start and end at the same park location. Please note tours may start a few minutes late or end a few minutes late depending on the amount of activity at the dock as this is a public boat ramp and dock.
data.group_size: 14-15 individuals non-private tour, 17 individuals for private tour. Infants must weigh 17 lbs or heavier

meeting_point.address: Goodland Boat Park, 750 Palm Point Dr., Goodland, FL 34140

data.what_is_included:
Shell Bags 
Bottled Water
Cooler with ice for guest use
data.what_is_not_included:
Gratuity for your captain and guide not included in price, so please don't forget to tip your crew!
Parking Pass at the park. Per Collier County Park rules, if you do not have a Collier County Beach Sticker on your vehicle you must purchase a $10 parking pass.
Snacks are not provided, but you're welcome to bring any food or drinks along with you.
Towels are not included
data.what_to_bring:
Please bring water! 
Shoes you do not mind getting wet, preferably water shoes, flip flops or sandals.
Sunscreen
Hat
Towel
Camera
Sun protective clothing
You are welcome to bring any other beverages, even 21+ drinks are allowed on board the vessels. 
Snacks, breakfast or lunch is welcome on board the vessel as well.
data.cancellation_summary: Customers receive a full refund for cancellations 48 hours before the booking. Cancellations, changes, or no-shows within 48 hours are charged in full. Operator cancellations get a full refund.
data.cancellation_notes: Customers will receive a full refund if they cancel their reservation 48 hours prior to the date and time of their booking, (customers will be charged in full within the 48 hour period before the booking). Changes on your reservation will be received 48 hours in advance, otherwise your will be charged in full for your original booking. Contact us by phone to cancel or inquire about a cancellation. No-shows will be charged the full price. Customers will also receive a full refund in case of operator cancellation due to weather or other unforeseen circumstances.
data.check_in_details:
Guests will need to sign our online waivers before check in. This can be found in the confirmation email. A text the day before or morning of the tour will be sent as a reminder of location and waivers. 

A crew member will be at the park waiting to check in all guests for the scheduled tour. Please look out for our shirts to know who to check in with. 
Once parked and checked in you will be instructed for a parking pass, where the bathroom is, and where to wait before the crew calls for their group. 

Please note that our company waits at the shaded pavilion ONLY for check in. You cannot go down to the docks or any other part of the park to find us. If you do not see our crew, call the office for information and assistance.
data.accessibility: Yes, please note there are 3 steps in and out of the boat from the dock.
data.special_requirements:
Infants must weigh more than 17 lbs to be on board any of our boats per Coast Guard Regulations. If under that weight, they are not allowed on board. 

All minors must be accompanied by an adult.

Service animals ONLY are allowed on the public boat tours and beaches. Dogs are allowed on Private Boat Tours only. Please note that dog owners are fully responsible for the dog throughout the tour, the captains and guides are not responsible for the dog at any point. Dog must remain leashed at all times both on the boat and on the beach. Cannot be off leash as it is prohibited.
data.restrictions:
Dogs and other animals considered pets are prohibited on the beaches or islands that we visit. Service animals only!

No restrictions, but please consult your doctor if you are pregnant or have medical care needs before booking the tour to ensure your safety. 

Please note that we do have a step stool to get in and out of the boat at the beach. Boat is parked directly on the beach, and it is rough 1-3 steps, depending on tide, to get off the boat and back into the boat. A railing is available to help balance.
data.extras: Life Jackets are available on the vessel, but are not required to be worn for adults or children during the tour. Your captain and crew will happily assist in putting them on or having them out for you per your request.
data.disclaimers:
Please understand that weather can change at any given moment that could prevent the tour from starting or result in your tour ending early. Our crew is constantly watching the radars to ensure all guests safety, it is their call to bring guests in early due to bad weather conditions.

If you or your guests in your party are not being respectful to your captain, guide, or other guests, the captain and guide have the right to return your group back to the dock. NO REFUND will be processed. 

Wildlife sightings can be unpredictable. We never know what the dolphins, birds or other wildlife are doing at any given time of day, or where they are hanging out. As you cruise around the islands, your captain is driving to all the known favorite spots of the dolphins. Sometimes this can take a little bit of time, so please be patient and understanding that your captain and guide are doing their best!
data.faqs:
Is there a restroom on board the vessel?
No. There is. public restroom at the marina we meet at for the check in. Once on the boat, it would be Mother Nature for a restroom.

What should we wear? Should we bring bathing suits?
Bathing suits are ideal, but outdoor comfortable wear is perfect! Guests are welcome to swim at the island beach. Just ensure you have comfortable shoes that can get wet to walk along the beaches. If a lot of shells, it can be uncomfortable to walk on.

Will we see dolphins?
Yes, your captain and guide will be looking for them on the way to and from the island, along with other wildlife you may come across. You will also get interesting facts about the species as well. 

How long are we shelling for?
About 30-45 minutes. This depends on how much wildlife is seen on the way to the island beach and the interests of the group. 

Will we find sand dollars?
Please let your captain and guide know that you wish to find sand dollars as some of the locations we like to go to do not have any sand dollars. There are only two specific locations we can go to to find sand dollars.
